tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// khro phu lo chen byams pa'i dpal gyi gsung rab las byung ba'i dngos grub kyi rdzas nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi mchod phreng 'dod rgu'i sprin chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dngos grub kyi rdzas nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi mchod pa zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dngos grub kyi dbang po'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// de la sdom ni/ rin chen shing dang dpag bsam shing*// bum bzang bdud rtsi khrus kyi rdzing*// 'dod 'jo'i ba dang cang shes rta// yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel st+rī// ma btab lo tog skyed mos tshal/ u dumbā ra rdzogs ldan sprin// bsam gtan lhung bzed rdo rje gri// ril bu rkang mgyogs mig sman bcud// thod le kor dang rdo rje dung*// rdzu 'phrul zhags pa nyi zla dang*// rin chen gter dang lcags kyo ste// grub pa nyi shu rtsa bdun no// zhes pa ltar gyis rim bzhin du mchod pa la/ rten gyi drung du so so'i gzugs brnyan 'bur du gtod pa'am/ ri mor bris pa sogs 'du bya/ de la dmigs te nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas rgyas par spel ba sngon du 'gro bas/ thal mo sbyar te snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas pas/ rang sngags bstun te pad kor gyis thog drangs so so'i dbyibs dang mthun pa'i phyag rgya bca' ba'am/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya kho nas kyang rung ste mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas 'bul tshig ni/ dge tshogs las grub rin chen bdun rang bzhin// yid 'ong sdong bu yal 'dab me tog rgyas// ro nus mchog smin 'bras tshogs g.yur za ba// sna tshogs rin chen ljon pas skyabs gsum mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra ratna bṛkṣa pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i snying po las 'khrungs shing*// 'dod rgu ster ba'i rin chen sdong chen po// ma lus lha rdzas mchod yon bsam mi khyab// bsam kun rang 'byung dpag bsam gyis mchod bgyi// sngags kyi thog mtha' 'dra ba la/

ratna bṛkṣa'i gnas su/ kalba bṛkṣa zhes bsgyur/ des mtshon te/ lha klu'i mdzod skyes rin chen bum bzang 'khyil// bdud rtsis lto gang lha rdzas mgul chings mdzes// sna tshogs gser dngul sdong pos kha brgyan pa// 'dod rgu'i rgyan 'bebs bum bzang 'di yang 'bul// su kumbha= gang reg mthong bas lus dang mig nad sel// thigs tsam gcig gis na dang 'chi 'joms byed// sman chen spyan stong ldan pa'i rtse gcig po// bdud rtsi'i rtsi mchog des kyang sras bcas mchod// a mṛ ta= shel sogs rin chen bzhi dngos rtsig skyabs ldan// yan lag brgyad ldan dri med chus gang zhing*// sna tshogs bya dang me tog phreng bas khebs// wa ti'i rgyun 'bebs padma'i rdzing bus mchod// padma khā ta/ dpal ldan nor gyi bdag po'i ne'u le bzhin// dgos kun rgyun 'babs yid bzhin ba rab bzang*// bkra shis mtshan dgu dul ba'i ngang tshul can// bsod nams stobs skyed 'dod 'jo'i ba mos mchod// kā ma dhe nu= yan lag legs gnas rma bya'i mgrin ltar sngo// kun nas lhun sdug sprin shugs ltar mgyogs shing*// chen po'i rkyen gyur rdzu 'phrul rkang par ldan// rta mchog cang shes de yis rgyal rnams mchod// tu raṃ ga= lha mi klu dbang cod pan snying po'i rgyan// sa gsum rgyal mtshan rtser bcings mchod 'os gang*// phyogs kun tha grur 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs pa// yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal pos mchod// tsintā ma ṇi= 'gro nang gzugs sgra dri ro reg pa'i mchog /kun nas yid 'ong skyon brgyas ma gos shing*// des bsam dngos kun thogs med rang sgrub byed// bud med gzugs can rin chen des kyang mchod// st+rī ratna= sbyin shugs las grub ma rmos ma btab par// phun tshogs lo tog ngo mtshar gang 'khrungs pa// mu ge nad gdon gnod pa kun sel ba'i// bkra shis lo tog des kyang khyed mchod do// maṅga la bṛ hi=

'jam yangs mnyam pa'i sa gzhir tsandan chus// rab brlan rab mdzes me tog rigs brgya 'khrungs// yid 'phrog ngad bsung rtsi sman rtsi bcud 'bras// dpag med kun rgyas skyed mos tshal 'di'ang 'bul// u ba pa na= bsdu bzhi gser brag skyibs 'khrungs rnyed dka' zhing*// 'dab stong rin chen 'od 'bar dpal brgya ldan// 'khor los sgyur rgyal thub dbang ltas gcig po// 'dab mdzes rgyal po u dumbā ras mchod// u dumbā ra= rab yangs mkha' la dge tshogs rlabs bskyed pas// dpal 'byor sprin dkrigs chos dang 'jig rten gyi// dgos 'byung char 'bebs snyan pa'i 'brug sgrogs pa// rdzogs ldan sprin chen des kyang 'gro dpal mchod// ma hā ga ya kṛ ta yu gaṃ= rnam kun ting 'dzin las bsgrubs lhung bzed mchog /thogs med 'gro mang re ba kun skong byed// rdzu 'phrul snod brten shākya'i phyag mtshan gang*// bsam gtan snod des drang srong rnams mchod bgyi// pa traṃ= pha lam las grub rno ngar stobs gsum ldan// yid shugs kyis bskyod dgos rgur rang 'gro zhing*// lha dbang mtshon cha gcod byed rgyal po ni// rdo rje ral gri des kyang khyed gus mchod// badzra khaḍga= sman chen rgyal po mkha' 'gros byin brlabs shing*// sbas pa'i gshog ldan brag ri nam mkhar yang*// thogs med brtul zhugs gsum gyi rtsal sbyin pa// dngos grub ril bu des kyang khyed mchod do// siddha go la= gangs ri'i spo la rtsi thog mi'am cis// legs blangs rnal 'byor rlung sems dbang bsgyur bas// lo zla zhag dang mthun mtshams chu tshod bzhir// rab sgrub rkang mgyogs des kyang khyed mchod bgyi// dza ba pā da= sgra sgrogs rgyal po dri za brgyas btsal rten// spyan lnga rjes mthun rgyang ring dngos mthong ba// shes rab ting 'dzin dran pa las byung mig /dngos grub rdzas chen des kyang khyed gus mchod// añdza na=

lha yul klu shing lha min gyis blangs sman// mi dbang za ma tog gi snying por bsgrubs// grub chen skye rgu tshe yi bcud bsdus pa// sman chen bcud kyi len des khyed mchod bgyi// rā sa yā na= sbyin dang bsam gtan brtse bas bsgyur byas pa// zla tshes ri mos rgyal blon skye bo dang*// yul rigs dbang sdud 'dod rgur dbang bsgyur ba// dngos grub thod le kor gyis khyed mchod do// kha ṭī ka= brgya byin gyis 'phangs sgra gcan mche ba bcag /sra brtan mi phyed phyogs bcur thal phyung gyur// zer phog tsam gyis ri bo thal bar byed// bar chad bzlog slad rdo rje 'bar bas mchod// badzra dzwa la= gsung sgra chos kyi dung ltar grags sgra sgrogs// gang gis sgra phyung ri rab gling bcas 'gul// ma lus snying la dad shugs dga' skyed pa// rin chen dung dkar de yis rgyal rnams mchod// ratna shaṃ kha= zla zer nyi zer thub 'od rgyan gyur pa// mi'am ci dbang bsod nams las grub cing*// che rnams yid kyis 'gugs byed don yod ming*// rdzu 'phrul zhags chen des kyang skyabs gsum mchod// ṛddhi pā sha= rta bdun rlung gis shugs bskyod 'gro ba yi// sgron gcig phyogs bcur rin chen me 'od 'byin// 'od 'dzin rgyal po rdzu 'phrul mthu chen po// padmo'i gnyen gyur nyi mas des kyang mchod// sūrya= sa gsum gdung sel dum bu shas tsam gyis// drag po'i gtsug rgyan 'jig rten gsum dpal gyur// gling bzhi'i mun sel nam mkha'i rgyan gnyis pa// zla rgyas bsil zer des kyang skyabs gsum mchod// tsand+ra= sa chen sbubs gtams shel sogs rnam bzhi'i sgrom// gang rnyed kun la 'dzad med phan 'byung ba// gling dgu sna tshogs rin chen rgyud 'brel phyug /'dod rgu'i gter chen de kyang dpal khyed mchod// ma hā ni dhi= lha min mtshon rno gnod sbyin mgar bas bzos// lcugs mdzes dkyus ring phra rgyas rab mdzes drang*// 'dod rgu kun 'gugs kun las rnam rgyal ba// rin chen lcags kyu des kyang khyed mchod bgyi// ratna aṅgu sha=

zhes phul ba'i mthar thal mo sbyar te/ byams chen sras bcas rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs// rdul snyed bdag lus gus btud thal sbyar te// bdun ldan nyi shu grub pa'i rdzas phul bas// mkha' khyab ma rnams 'dod rgu'i lhun grub shog /ces 'dod don gsol/ 'dir mtshan sngags spyir btang yin la/ dmigs bsal gang la 'bul ba'i mtshan sngags sbyar te/ mgon po byams pa gtso bor byas te 'bul na/ sarba ta thā ga ta'i mal du/mai tri nā tha zhes dang*/ rnam thos sras kyi mchod chog la/ bai shra wa ṇa zhes bsgyur bas mtshon te shes par bya'o// dngos grub kyi rdzas nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi mchod pa zhes bya ba/ dge slong byams pa'i dpal gyis sbyar ba rdzogs so// slar yang so so'i ming sngags bar du bcug pa sogs ngag 'don gyi phreng bar mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bsdebs pa'i dge bas 'jig rten du dge legs 'dod rgu'i sprin chen las dngos grub kyi char rgyun dus rtag tu 'jo bar gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// khro phu lo chen gyi gsung rab las byung ba'i grub pa nyer bdun gyi mchod phreng phyag rgya so sor byed na/ rin chen ljon pa la/ thal mo khong stong gung mo rtse sprad/ srin lag padma ltar kha bye/ lhag ma lo 'dab kyi tshul du bsgreng*/ dpag bsam shing la/ thal mo mthil sprad/ sor mo'i rtse sbyar ba zlum po 'bras bu ltar bya/ bum pa bzang por/ rtags brgyad kyi bum pa'i rgya/ bdud rtsi la/ g.yon padma ltar kha phye/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi lan tshul bya/ padma'i rdzing bur/ thal mo brkyangs pa'i sor mo rtse bkug pa padma'i rdzing bu ltar/ 'dod 'jo'i ba la/ thal mo thad kar sor rtse sprad pa zlum po/ mthe bong rwa ltar bsgreng*/ rta mchog la/ sna bdun gyi rta mchog ltar/ nor bu la/ sna bdun gyi nor bu ltar/ btsun mo la/ sna bdun gyi btsun mo ltar/ ma rmos lo tog la/ thal mo brkyangs pa'i sor mo rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrengs pa lo tog gi tshul/

skyed mos tshal la/ thal mo mnyam par brkyang*/ u dumbā ra la/ padma'i rgya/ rdzogs ldan sprin la/ nam mkha' mdzod rgya/ lhung bzed la/ thal mo brkyangs nas mdzub rtse cung zad bkug pa lhung bzed 'degs pa'i rgya/ ral gri la/ g.yon khu tshur snying ga g.yas khu tshur gung mdzub bsgrengs pa ral gri'i rgya/ ril bur/ thal mo kha phyir bstan te brkyangs pa'i mtheb mdzub zlum por sprad/ rkang mgyogs la/ thal mo gnyis snying ga'i thad nas thur du sbubs te brkyangs pa mchil lh+wam gyi rgya/ mig sman la/ thal mo gnyis mtheb mdzub sprad pas mig sman byugs tshul/ bcud len/ thal mo gnyis nu ma'i thad du brkyangs te mtheb mdzub sbyar ba bcud len gyi snod 'degs tshul/ thod le kor la/ g.yon khu tshur/ g.yas khu tshur la mtheb mdzub sbyar bas zla tshes bri tshul/ rdo rjer/ rdo rje'i rgya/ dung la/ dung gi rgya/ don yod zhags par/ mtheb mdzub sbyar nas sbrel ba zhags mig ltar/ nyi ma la/ thal mo mthil sbyar/ sor mo rnams bsgrengs pa nyi zer gyi rgya/ zla bar/ thal mo khong stong zlum po zla ba ltar bya/ gter chen por/ thal mo snying ga'i thad du mthil zlum por sbyar/ gung srin rdo rje phyi bsdam mtha' bzhi thad ka dang*/ mthe bong steng du bsgrengs pa gter gyi sgrom bu'i rgya/ rin chen lcags kyur/ g.yon khu tshur snying ga g.yas khu tshur las mdzub mo brkyangs te rtse bkug pa phrag pa'i thad bskor ba lcags kyus 'debs pa'i rgya'o// de so sor thog mar pad kor gyis gzhi blangs te so so'i phyag rgya dang*/ mthar se gol gtogs pas 'jog pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o//
